name: 632. A batch create past its provider's line limit is refused before any line is converted (batch line limit)
description: Local fixture regression for TXE-7696, no live provider calls. fixture-folders.mjs's video-settlement group starts tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs and a gateway on tests/e2e/api/provider_config/video-settlement.config.json, whose openai provider has one batch-enabled key for results-bound-model on the fixture. Run with videoSettlementFixture=1 and videoSettlementFixtureUrl; every case is skipped otherwise. Each provider's BatchCreate refuses a batch with more inline lines than its vendor's published per-batch maximum (core/providers/utils/batchlines.go) before it converts a line: OpenAI's is 50,000. A create of 50,001 lines, built by the row's pre-request script, is a 400 caller_invalid_request on requests whose message names the limit, and the fixture's hit counters show no file upload and no batch create. Red before: on main the gateway converted all 50,001 lines, uploaded them and created the batch, so the create was a 200 and the fixture counted file.upload 1 and results_bound.create 1.
